summary: Soulpower Acquisition Corp. filed an 8-K disclosing issuance of a $2.5 million unsecured promissory note (B Note) to sponsor affiliate Soulpower Management LLC. The note is non-interest bearing, non-convertible, and will be forgiven automatically upon consummation of an initial business combination; otherwise due at liquidation or default. Proceeds are for general working capital. The lender is controlled by CEO Justin Lafazan. This is a classic SPAC working capital bridge loan, a routine funding mechanism to extend the SPAC's runway while it seeks a target. Watch for the SPAC's deadline to announce/complete a deal; the note structure may create tension between sponsor and public shareholders.
